label: Ubiquiti UniFi Device Bridge IoT
description: Compact IoT wireless bridge: one 10/100M RJ45 port, internal antenna plus RP-SMA for an external omni.
notes: Vendor figures from the Ubiquiti tech specs page: Networking Interface **(1) 10/100M RJ45 port**, one internal antenna plus RP-SMA for an external omni, channel bandwidth 20/40 MHz, **45 g**. Two limits for an IoT install: the port is **fast Ethernet** so a 100 Mbps ceiling applies to everything bridged, and the radio is 20/40 MHz only - it cannot use an 80 MHz channel, which is the right trade for range but wrong if you expected the Device Bridge's rates.
